deviceSessions.heading: Sign-ins & devices
deviceSessions.sessionData: Every sign-in stores that session's IP address and device type (User-Agent) — that has always been true. What's new: when you sign in from a new device via QR code, you now see that data yourself — as a comparison aid on the confirmation screen, and in your own device list in Profile, where you can sign each session out individually.
deviceSessions.geoIp: For QR-code sign-in we additionally resolve the requesting device's IP address to a country (e.g. "Germany"), never anything more precise — this helps you tell a stranger's request apart from your own. That resolution runs entirely on our own EU servers, against a self-hosted database we keep up to date; your IP address never leaves our infrastructure and is never sent to a third-party provider. If the database is out of date or an address can't be matched, we honestly show "Region unknown" rather than guess.

taggeld.widerspruch: This contradicts the wage statement: the AHV contributions in box 9 fit the wage without the benefit of {{betrag}}, which points to an insurance benefit. Choose continued pay only if the benefit statement or the monthly payslips show it (AHV-subject wage of the employer); otherwise tax-free money is taxed.

That points to an insurance benefit, which is no AHV wage. Ziffer 9 can also hold the NBU premium; the benefit statement decides.
ahv.fits_with: Plausibility hint (not a decision): the contributions in Ziffer 9 ({{ziffer9}}) fit the gross wage with the daily benefit (AHV/IV/EO and ALV about {{mit}}) better than without it (about {{ohne}}), by {{abstand}}. That points to the money being paid as wage, i.e. continued pay by the employer. Ziffer 9 can also hold the NBU premium; the benefit statement decides.
ahv.too_close: Plausibility hint (not a decision): with and without the daily benefit the contributions in Ziffer 9 would be almost the same (about {{mit}} and {{ohne}}); they cannot tell the source apart.
ahv.nbu_likely: Plausibility hint (not a decision): Ziffer 9 ({{ziffer9}}) holds more than AHV/IV/EO and ALV on the whole gross wage (about {{mit}}), likely the NBU premium too; it does not show where the daily benefit came from.
ahv.fits_neither: Plausibility hint (not a decision): Ziffer 9 ({{ziffer9}}) is well below the contributions with the daily benefit (about {{mit}}) and without it (about {{ohne}}); it does not show where the daily benefit came from.

anlagen.berichtigungHinweis: If the share for which you may deduct input VAT changes within five years (buildings: ten), the deduction is corrected each year in part. A move into or out of the small business rule counts too. Up to 1,000 € of input VAT there is no correction.

ust.kleinGrenzeGruendung: In the founding year the small business rule only holds up to {{grenze}} turnover. Your book shows {{umsatz}}: check in the profile whether you have to charge VAT.
ust.kleinGrenzeVorjahr: Your turnover last year was above {{grenze}}. The small business rule does not apply this year: check this in the profile.
ust.kleinGrenzeJahr: Your turnover this year, {{umsatz}}, is above {{grenze}}. The small business rule ends: check this in the profile.
ust.kleinVorjahrUnbekannt: There is no book for last year here. The small business rule only applies if last year's turnover was at most {{grenze}}.
ust.kleinAb: From the supply of {{datum}} the small business rule no longer applies: that supply and all later ones are subject to VAT, the earlier ones stay exempt (§ 19 Abs. 1 UStG). Book them with VAT from that day and invoice with VAT.
ust.berichtigung15aHinweis: Positive: more input VAT, negative: to pay back. In Mein ELSTER enter the total in the line „Berichtigung des Vorsteuerabzugs (§ 15a UStG)“.
ust.berichtigung15aVa: already in the prepayment return (above 6,000 € or a sale, § 44 Abs. 3 UStDV)

gewst.entfaellt: As a freelancer you pay no trade tax.

sonder.aufgabeHinweis: The gain is taxed beside the current profit, on application with an allowance and at a reduced rate. A sole trader owes no trade tax on it.

feld.priceEur: Sale price or value of the assets taken over (€)
feld.capitalAccountEur: Value of the business assets (capital account) at that date (€)

sonder.thesaurierungHinweis: With a balance sheet, profits you leave in the business can be taxed at a fixed rate on application; withdrawing them later is taxed at 25 %.

sonder.vortrag: Amount subject to recapture at year end

lohn.kircheOhneZeile: The wage tax return of your federal state has no line of its own for {{kuerzel}}, or the municipality key in the profile is missing. The church tax is only in the total (Kz 83); ask your tax office where it belongs.
